name: Otter pet
description: An otter that floats over the window: drag it anywhere. It types while a terminal works, waves when one needs you, cries when one failed, sleeps when nothing works. A bubble says what Claude finished where you aren't looking; a click opens it. Right-click for its menu. One otter, or one per group.
author: Willy Sotomayor

settings.label: Tell me about
settings.help: When Otterm isn't the window in front, every terminal counts as not looked at.

settings.label: When a terminal finishes, the bubble shows

choices.label: The first sentence of Claude's reply

settings.label: Otters

choices.label: One per group, in a raft

settings.help: With one per group, each otter wears its group's color and shows how that group is doing. Each device can pick its own in the otter's menu.

settings.label: Character
settings.help: Every one has every pose. Each device can pick its own in the menu.

settings.label: Put on hats
settings.help: The agent's (orange for Claude, slate for Codex: the agent of the terminal the otter is showing), and a nightcap to sleep in at night.

settings.label: Size
settings.help: Each device can pick its own in the otter's menu.

settings.label: Falls asleep when no terminal has worked for
Tell me when a terminal's context is nearly full
settings.help: When Otterm shows its context in red, with a Compact button for Claude (it needs the type permission).

settings.label: Tell me when the 5-hour limit is used up to
settings.help: Once per 5-hour window. Empty for no warning.

settings.label: Suggest a break after working for
settings.help: Counts while you type or click in Otterm; 10 minutes away is a break. Empty for no reminder.

settings.label: Quiet hours
settings.help: No bubbles between these times, such as 22:00-08:00. The otter still shows how the terminals are doing.

settings.label: Show it on paired phones and laptops too
